content.text:
Now I can cross-reference both lists. Let me identify the overlap:

**Ripple of Hope Award winners before 2017 who also won a Nobel Prize before 2010:**

1. **Desmond Tutu** — Nobel Peace Prize 1984; Ripple of Hope Award 2008
2. **Muhammad Yunus** — Nobel Peace Prize 2006; Ripple of Hope Award 2013
3. **Al Gore** — Nobel Peace Prize 2007; Ripple of Hope Award 2011

These three individuals meet both criteria: they received the Ripple of Hope Award before 2017 and won a Nobel Prize before 2010.

## Sources
- Ripple of Hope Award laureates: [Robert F. Kennedy Human Rights - Ripple of Hope Award Laureates](https://kennedyhumanrights.org/awards/ripple-of-hope-award/ripple-of-hope-award-laureates)
- Nobel Prize laureates: [Wikipedia - List of Nobel laureates](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Nobel_laureates)
